## Scope and edition

Name the OAL edition and describe whether this affects normative wording, a translation, a guide, a model, an engine definition, a derivation record, or an example.

## Affected object type

Layer metamodel · reusable model · project artifact · transformer construction · transformer execution. State which objects the change touches and which it leaves unchanged.

## Contract change and correspondence

Identify changed use cases, criteria, permissions, or contracts, or state that none are affected. Note any affected case identities and their behavioral tests.

## Derivation, model, and interaction mapping

Name affected source and destination baselines, the accountable person, the model status (specified or unspecified), any engine claim, and ADIB element-to-case links. Do not present a combined package or a coexistence of artifacts as an executed transformation.

## Verification actually performed

Include the commands and their results, with the environment. Do not claim runs not performed, and separate planned checks from executed evidence.

## Versioning and attribution

Identify whether the change is editorial or requires a new normative edition, and preserve authorship and credits.
